g.text: SOURCING — every channel has its own ingestion script
THE HEARTBEAT — agent outputs, corrections, decisions flow back in
embed — runs on CPU, GPU kept for the brain
LLM extracts entities + relationships (custom GraphRAG, batched)
agent session (Telegram / VS Code / web) starts fresh
Mem0 — loads what matters for this task, now
synthesise: vector recall + graph context → one answer
